sn16.6:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.6:1.5: ahaṃ vā kassapa, bhikkhū ovadeyyaṃ tvaṃ vā,
sn16.6:1.6: ahaṃ vā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyyaṃ tvaṃ vāti.
sn16.6:2.1: dubbacā kho bhante bhagavā, etarahi bhikkhū dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā, akkhamā, appadakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ.
sn16.6:2.2: idhāhaṃ bhante, addasaṃ bhaṇḍuñca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ, ābhiñjikañca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ, aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadante
sn16.6:2.3: “ehi bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:3.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
sn16.6:3.2: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena bhaṇḍuñca bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ, ābhiñjikañca bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ āmantehi
sn16.6:3.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
sn16.6:4.1: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho pana te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.6:4.2: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave, aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadatha,
sn16.6:4.3: “ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:4.5: kinnu me tumhe bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha?
sn16.6:4.7: ‘ehi bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:4.9: no ce kira tumhe bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ajānātha, atha kiñcarahi tumhe moghapurisā, kiṃ jānantā kiṃ passantā evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadatha:
sn16.6:4.10: “ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:5.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn16.6:5.2: accayo no bhante, accagamā yathābāle, yathā mūḷhe, yathā akusale ye mayaṃ evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadimhā
sn16.6:5.3: “ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:5.4: tesaṃ no bhante, bhagavā accayaṃ accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
sn16.6:6.1: taṅgha tumhe bhikkhave, accayo accagamā, yathā bāle yathā mūḷhe yathā akusale, ye tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadittha:
sn16.6:6.2: “ehi bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī”ti.
sn16.6:6.3: yato ca kho tumhe bhikkhave, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarotha, taṃ vo mayaṃ accayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma.
sn16.6:6.4: vuddhi hesā bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti, āyatiñca saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
